headline: Mediterrania Capital Partners ventures into venture capital with MC Outlierz Ventures
summary: Mediterrania Capital Partners, which manages 1.2 billion euros in assets, is entering venture capital through MC Outlierz Ventures, targeting early-stage African tech startups in AI, fintech and health.
why: Mediterrania Capital Partners is a private equity manager focused on Africa and the Mediterranean, and its venture push adds capital for startups.
original_headline: Mediterrania Capital Partners se lance dans le capital-risque avec MC Outlierz Ventures
